name: suede-recommend-next-action
description: Next-action selector for this pack: reads current repo, terminal, plan, or handoff state, scores 2-4 candidate moves against goal alignment, unblocking, evidence, urgency, and leverage, and returns one recommended action plus a short, self-contained copy/paste prompt — expanding into a full operator prompt or granular steps only on request. Use when the user asks 'what's next', 'what should I do next', 'recommend the next move', 'give me the prompt', 'expand prompt', or 'make it granular', espec
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 根据当前项目进展判断最值得做的下一步，并生成可直接执行的提示词，适合卡住或不确定如何推进时使用。
